definitions.explanation: A person of Japanese nationality or ethnicity. Can refer to individuals or collectively to the Japanese people.

examples.japanese: {日本人|にほんじん}の{友達|ともだち}がいます。
{日本人|にほんじん}は{礼儀|れいぎ}{正|ただ}しいと{言|い}われている。
examples.english: Japanese people are said to be polite.

notes:
{日本人|にほんじん} refers to people of Japanese nationality or descent. Formed from {日本|にほん} + {人|じん} (person), following the standard pattern for nationality words.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {日本人|にほんじん}{観光客|かんこうきゃく}: Japanese tourists
- {日本人|にほんじん}{選手|せんしゅ}: Japanese athlete
- {日本人|にほんじん}として: as a Japanese person
- {日本人|にほんじん}{離|ばな}れした: un-Japanese (in appearance or behavior)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {邦人|ほうじん}: Japanese national (formal, used in news — {邦人|ほうじん}{保護|ほご} "protection of nationals")
- {日本|にほん}{国籍|こくせき}: Japanese nationality (legal term)

PRONUNCIATION:
The reading にほんじん is standard. にっぽんじん is also used, especially in formal or patriotic contexts.
